terms.pageDescription: Slim terms of use — service definition, disclaimer, governing law, operator identification.
terms.heading: Terms of Use
terms.draftNotice: [en] These Terms are a draft. Not final until legal review (PLAN 4.12.f) is complete.
terms.serviceDefinitionBody: [en] Slim is an information service that compares telecom plans in Belgium (BE), the Netherlands (NL), and Luxembourg (LU). Slim does not provide telecom services directly and is not a party to any contract between a provider and a user.
terms.comparisonDisclaimerBody: [en] Slim displays tariff information as provided by operators without modification. Savings calculations are arithmetic estimates based on input assumptions and may differ from actual savings. Slim does not warrant the completeness, accuracy, or timeliness of comparison results. Please verify current tariffs directly on the operator's official website before concluding any contract.
terms.affiliateBody: [en] Slim may receive affiliate commissions from some providers. Commissions do not affect user tariffs, and comparison rankings are determined solely by algorithm regardless of affiliate status. See the affiliate disclosure page for details.
terms.privacyRefBody: [en] For information on how personal data collected during the service (postal code, household type, current provider, etc.) is processed, please refer to our Privacy Policy.
terms.liabilityBody: [en] As an information service, Slim is not liable, to the maximum extent permitted by law, for any damages resulting from contracts concluded or tariff changes made based on comparison results.
terms.governingLawBody: [en] These Terms are governed by and construed in accordance with Belgian law. Disputes shall be resolved before the competent Belgian courts.
terms.operatorBody: [en] The operator of this service is identified below. For inquiries, please contact us by email.

privacy.pageDescription: Slim GDPR Art.13 Privacy Policy — data collected, legal basis, retention periods, data subject rights.
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.draftNotice: [en] This Privacy Policy is a draft. Not final until legal review (PLAN 4.12.f) is complete.
privacy.directCollectionNote: [en] This policy is an Art.13 direct-collection notice. Slim does not collect personal data indirectly from third parties (Art.14 not applicable).
privacy.controllerBody: [en] The data controller for this service is identified below.
privacy.dpoBody: [en] This service is not required to designate a DPO under GDPR Art.37 (sole trader, no high-risk processing).
privacy.processingPA01Purpose: [en] Purpose: Calculate and provide telecom plan comparison results based on user input (postal code, household type, current provider, usage).
privacy.processingPA01LegalBasis: [en] Legal basis: GDPR Art.6(1)(b) — performance of the comparison service contract.
privacy.processingPA01Data: [en] Data collected: Postal code (PC4), household type, current provider ID, per-category usage. No IP or device information collected.
privacy.processingPA02Heading: [en] PA-02 Permanent Storage of Comparison Results
privacy.processingPA02Purpose: [en] Purpose: Provide a permanent link (/r/[shortId]) so comparison results can be retrieved at any time.
privacy.processingPA02LegalBasis: [en] Legal basis: GDPR Art.6(1)(b) — service performance.
privacy.processingPA03Purpose: [en] Purpose: Record that a user navigated to an affiliate provider's site after giving consent, and settle commission.
privacy.processingPA03LegalBasis: [en] Legal basis: Art.6(1)(a) consent (click record) + Art.6(1)(c) legal obligation (Belgian accounting retention).
privacy.processingPA04Purpose: [en] Purpose: Detect security incidents and monitor system anomalies.
privacy.processingPA04LegalBasis: [en] Legal basis: Art.6(1)(f) legitimate interests — service security operations.
privacy.processingPA05Purpose: [en] Purpose: Send one follow-up email 7 days after an affiliate click (beta conversion measurement).
privacy.processingPA05LegalBasis: [en] Legal basis: Art.6(1)(a) explicit consent (separate checkbox, pre-checked=false).
privacy.legitimateInterestBody: [en] PA-04 Security Logging: Detecting fraud and malicious access constitutes a legitimate interest in service security. Balance with data subject interests: data collected is minimised and proportionate to the security purpose.
privacy.recipientsBody: [en] PA-01/PA-02 comparison data is not transferred externally. Third-party data processors are listed below.
privacy.recipientSentry: [en] Sentry — error monitoring (security log). Sentry Inc. (US, SCCs applied).
privacy.recipientPostHog: [en] PostHog — product analytics (security log). EU region option used.
privacy.recipientNeon: [en] Neon — database hosting. EU-Central-1 (Frankfurt). Neon DPA in place.
privacy.recipientVercel: [en] Vercel — service hosting. EU edge deployment (FRA1).
privacy.recipientResend: [en] Resend — follow-up email sending (PA-05). EU region used.
privacy.recipientAffiliateNote: [en] Affiliate redirects: Users navigate directly to provider sites via browser. Slim does not transmit personal data to providers (not a GDPR third-party transfer).
privacy.internationalTransferBody: [en] Neon, Resend, and PostHog use EU regions. Sentry is a US entity; transfers are governed by SCCs (Standard Contractual Clauses). Transfer adequacy details will be confirmed by external audit (pre-beta).
privacy.retentionPA01: [en] Comparison request PII (postal code, household type, usage): 90 days. Thereafter generalised or set to NULL.
privacy.retentionPA02: [en] Comparison results: retained permanently (permanent link SLA). PII-derived fields within results: NULL after 90 days.
privacy.retentionPA03Click: [en] Affiliate click FKs: SET NULL after 90 days. Settlement fields: Belgian accounting obligation (7–10 years).
privacy.retentionPA05Email: [en] Email address: NULL immediately after successful sending. Meta columns: deleted after 90 days.
privacy.rightsBody: [en] Data subjects may exercise the following rights by contacting the controller at the email address below.
privacy.rightWithdraw: [en] Right to withdraw consent (Art.7(3)) — affiliate consent, follow-up email consent, and analytics cookie consent can each be withdrawn separately.
privacy.withdrawConsentBody: [en] Processing based on Art.6(1)(a) consent (PA-03/PA-05/analytics cookies) may be withdrawn at any time. Withdrawal methods: affiliate consent — contact operator email; follow-up email — 1-click unsubscribe in the email; analytics cookies — Cookie settings below.
privacy.supervisoryBody: [en] Data subjects may lodge a complaint with the following supervisory authorities.
privacy.supervisoryBE: [en] Belgium: Autorité de protection des données (APD) / Gegevensbeschermingsautoriteit (GBA) — www.autoriteprotectiondonnees.be
privacy.supervisoryLU: [en] Luxembourg: Commission nationale pour la protection des données (CNPD) — www.cnpd.public.lu
privacy.obligationBody: [en] Comparison request inputs (postal code, household type, usage) are necessary for service performance (Art.6(1)(b)). If not provided, comparison results cannot be calculated.
privacy.automatedDecisionBody: [en] Slim's comparison engine performs only arithmetic savings calculations. There is no automated individual decision-making or profiling within the meaning of GDPR Art.22. Comparison rankings are not based on profiling of personal characteristics, but are the arithmetic result of comparing provider tariff data against input assumptions.
privacy.contactBody: [en] For privacy inquiries and rights requests, please contact us at the email address below.
